text:
Hello night crew,
Eventful stint at the desk, and traveler questions came up

A few callers were steady and practical, and a few needed a calmer walk-through of the travel steps before they felt set. I kept the tone simple: confirm the booking path, review what the animal needs, and make sure the handoff stays smooth from start to finish. The best help we can give is clear, patient guidance that leaves travelers feeling backed up rather than rushed.

One note from the thread: <<FACT F051>> We should keep leaning into that same steady style when the next wave comes in. If a traveler sounds worried, slow the pace, use plain language, and keep the focus on what they can do next. That has been helping a lot with smoother conversations, and it keeps the desk from turning into a scramble.

Please keep flagging anything odd or unclear so we can catch it early and protect the animal and the traveler alike. Stella was a good reminder that every animal gets patient attention from trained staff, and that calm handling makes the whole trip easier. Thanks for staying sharp and kind through the late stretch tonight.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
